channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: South Yorkshire spa and wellness retreat sold off £1.3m guide price - "a fantastic wellness-sector business with great growth potential"
item.description: A spa and wellness retreat in South Yorkshire has been acquired off a guide price of £1.3m.

item.title: Award-winning restaurant near to England and Wales' oldest golf course is on the market
item.description: A restaurant in the South West, which is near to the oldest golf course in England and Wales, is up for sale.

item.title: Pie brand which has attracted a cult following in Cardiff heads to London for Six Nations 2026 residency
item.description: A cult Welsh pie and coffee brand born in Cardiff is returning to the London Welsh Centre for a Six Nations 2026 takeover.

item.title: Well-known businessman Mo Chaudry launches £5m fund to back aspiring entrepreneurs
item.description: Mo Chaudry has launched a £5m fund using his own personal money with the aim of helping entrepreneurs launch or grow their businesses in and around Stoke-on-Trent.

item.title: Lakeside Windermere hotel development opportunity brought to market
item.description: A hotel development opportunity situated on the western shore of Lake Windermere in the heart of the Lake District has been brought to market with an asking price of £2.5m.

item.title: Additional funding to better protect canals across England and Wales
item.description: An additional £6.5m government funding has been announced to support the repair and maintenance of canals across England and Wales, as well as long-term projects.

item.title: Strong progress on new South Yorkshire distribution centre for discount retailer
item.description: Strong progress has been made on the construction of a new distribution centre in South Yorkshire that will support hundreds of discount retail stores nationwide.

item.title: Yorkshire profit warnings fall by almost a third in 2025 - lowest total since 2021
item.description: The number of profit warnings issued by Yorkshire-based listed companies fell by almost a third in 2025, according to EY-Parthenon's latest Profit Warnings report.

item.title: Eight innovative tech firms to pitch for investment at Reading Tech Cluster event
item.description: Reading Tech Cluster, a non-profit organisation supporting the region's technology sector, is set to host an investment pitch event later this month for promising start-ups and scale-ups.

item.title: Milestone for major Lichfield housing development
item.description: A new neighbourhood on the edge of Lichfield has reached a milestone with the opening of a show home.
